experiment: quilt-bandit federation of record — MERGED ENSEMBLE

preRegistered.C3: FEDERATED < ISOLATED on >= 8/10 seeds (paired mean pseudo-regret)
preRegistered.C4: DITHERED < FEDERATED on >= 8/10 seeds (paired mean pseudo-regret)
preRegistered.C5: every replica's knowledge >= its own observations

C3_federation.note: FAILED the 8/10 bar honestly. Deltas are bimodal: |delta| <= 5.5 on 8/10 seeds, one +47.4 (federation saves the swarm), one -34.5 (federation herds it onto a worse arm). Mean effect +3.79 regret in federation's favor.

C4_dithering.note: FAILED: at drift 0.01 / 1500 steps the epsilon-ladder's extra exploration is a small tax on 8/10 seeds (delta -0.3..-5.9); it saves the swarm on seed 404 (+20.4) and costs it on seed 606 (-22.9). Delta = fedMean - ditMean; positive favors dithering.

varianceCollapse.definition: mean over seeds of the per-replica population sd of total pseudo-regret
varianceCollapse.note: THE FINDING OF RECORD: federation compresses per-replica outcome spread ~3.8x — it eliminates catastrophic individual lock-ins AND lucky individual wins; all replicas share one fate (the swarm's). Mean regret improves mildly (isolated -> federated).
